title: Decide the canonical spelling of contract file paths after the cloudflare move
description:
The pinned bundle's lifecycle-invariants.json names cloud/factory/** in its `today` sites and threshold `file` paths. ticfac's copy now lives at ticfac/cloudflare, so l9n added a reader-side mapping (contractSourcePath in internal/factory/lifecycle/contract_test.go) and correctly left the contract itself untouched — a consumer does not get to rewrite a shared contract to suit its own layout.

That mapping is now an undocumented convention that the NEXT consumer will re-derive independently, which is how two readers end up disagreeing about the same contract.

Decide at the next bundle cut, and write the decision down:
 (a) the cloud/factory/** paths stay canonical-as-ticks, and the reader-side mapping becomes the documented permanent shape, or
 (b) the bundle carries a location-neutral spelling and every consumer drops its mapping.

Whichever wins, the losing option should be impossible to adopt by accident — a test or a bundle-check, not a comment.

Found by l9n, run epic-ncv, finding 0c0654b2.
acceptance_criteria: The bundle documents one canonical spelling; contractSourcePath either matches the documented mapping or is deleted; a check fails if a consumer re-derives its own
